public_intel.text: Reports mention shouting at Market square (C) and an unattended radio at Canal gate (D). Both reports passed through the same dispatcher; neither confirms an exposure inside a shelter.

An archived 09:18 record identifies the shouting at Market square (C) as a loading dispute. The original Canal gate (D) radio report is still incomplete. These records describe events before the mission.
The recovered 09:24 East gate (E) log records a visitor arriving from Canal gate (D), without a health check. It does not establish the visitor's condition or East gate's current status.

ground_truth_timeline.text: Canal gate (D) is the only initially exposed shelter. All other shelters begin at pressure 0. No shelter begins Overrun.

The market incident was unrelated to exposure. The archived East gate visitor record does not represent a second initial exposure or add pressure to the simulation. Later pressures depend exclusively on player actions and the existing resolution rules.
